# AI Club — Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS) Gwalior

> Official collegiate artificial intelligence and computing research collective at MITS Gwalior. Developing student-led open-source research across machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and distributed systems.

## Sections
- [Events](/events): National hackathons, hands-on CUDA workshops, and machine learning reading groups.
- [Projects](/projects): Open-source repositories, neural architectures, and hardware prototypes.
- [Research & GD](/research): Student research labs, preprints, and active discussions.
- [Team](/team): Core members, domain leads, faculty coordinators, and student developers.
- [About](/about): Club mission, computational facility history, and technical infrastructure.
- [Join](/join): Student membership intake, role tracks, and application information.

## Primary Facility
- Campus: Madhav Institute of Technology & Science (MITS-DU), Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Official Email: aiclub@mitsgwalior.in
